title: The Spore Broker's Fog Tax
story: In the cavern night market, Fenwillow the Spore Broker has fenced off a hut of sleeping mushroom-folk and will only lift the fence if Mr 6 buys the gear to do it himself. The gnome-hats behind the stall whisper that Fenwillow sneaks a "fog tax" onto every bill. Mr 6 counts out his purse of 90 gold crowns and starts a very careful list.
question: Mr 6 needs 4 rope coils at 12.5 gold crowns each plus one glow-lantern at 18.75 gold crowns, and Fenwillow adds a 20% fog tax to the whole bill. How many gold crowns are left from his 90-crown purse?
solution: The ropes cost 4 x 12.5 = 50 crowns, so the bill before tax is 50 + 18.75 = 68.75 crowns.
A 20% fog tax makes it 68.75 x 1.2 = 82.5 crowns.
Change from the purse is 90 - 82.5 = 7.5 gold crowns left.
praise: Adding up the items first was the smart opening move — the step still waiting was growing the bill by 20% before subtracting from 90.
hint: Find the bill first, then make it 20% bigger, and only then see what the purse has left.
victory: Mr 6 paid, untied the fence himself, and handed Fenwillow the 7.5 crowns of change as a tip for "excellent arithmetic practice" — the broker turned fog-pink and vanished into his own mist.
imagePrompt: A lanky mushroom-capped broker behind a glowing stall in an underground night market, spores drifting like snow, as a small knightly number six counts shining coins beside a fenced hut of sleepy mushroom-folk.
